title: 15K4JR3B (Easy Version)
statement: The task is to maximize the doubled area of a triangle whose three vertices start at the origin and must be moved with exactly n unit axis-parallel steps, with n up to 1000. Each vertex costs its Manhattan distance from the origin and the bounding box's width plus height is at most n, so the answer is floor(n/2)·ceil(n/2): two vertices on the x-axis, one on the y-axis.
